ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Response to Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's response to child care fraud, including the recent probe in Minnesota.
questions: What is the scope of the child care fraud probe in Minnesota?
How has the Trump administration responded to the probe?
ideas.insight: The Trump administration's response to child care fraud is a critical issue that requires further investigation. By analyzing public records and following the money, we can determine the scope of the probe and the administration's response.
